title: European Football Championship Eth Betting Game
main_content:
Place your bets in ETH’s football challenge: The European Football Championship should have actually taken place last year, but the coronavirus pandemic forced it to reschedule to this summer. The games will finally begin on 11 June, kicking off in 11 different cities simultaneously.

You can enhance your European Championship experience by taking part in the betting challenge on ETH’s Point platform. The game is open to all members of the ETH community, who are welcome to participate as individuals or in teams.

The game is already up on Point and ready for you to enter your picks.

Prizes for winners: Of course, there are also great prizes to be won:

1st place: CHF 150 restaurant gift certificate to Linde Oberstrass Zunfthaus und Bierbrauerei .

2nd and 3rd place: A chocolatey surprise for everyone in the team (maximum of 6 people per group).

1st place: CHF 150 gift certificate from TRANSA and a chocolatey football surprise.

2nd and 3rd place: Gift certificate/gift box from Zum guten Heinrich , approximately CHF 60 value.

Not all players with unlucky picks will go home empty handed. Point also has prizes for those who end up in 50th and 100th place:

50th place: Two tickets to the FIFA Museum (courtesy of the FIFA Museum)

100th place: CHF 30 gift certificate to the ETH Store and one Keep Cup (courtesy of the ETH Store)

Betting game at a glance: It pays to play!

• Sign up and submit your picks on Point
• Point group: Information on the betting challenge and discussion forums
• Information on the external page European Football Championship call_made
